blocks.title: Final framing
blocks.text: Window functions turn multi-pass, self-join-heavy SQL into one declarative sorted pass. Learn the frame defaults and most surprises vanish.

caption.text: Part 2 of SQL WINDOW FUNCTIONS. Your running total is quietly wrong and SQL will never tell you — the default frame is RANGE, so two rows sharing a timestamp both show the day-end figure. This 12-page handbook works through window functions end to end: the OVER grammar, PARTITION BY, the frame defaults nobody reads, ranking, LAG/LEAD, execution order, and the twelve mistakes that produce silently wrong numbers. Save it for the next time you catch yourself joining a table to itself on an inequality.
